scope: Corrected connected related-board vertical ENP/clock wiring and receipt-backed isolated native counters; no full Sheriff raster/graphics qualification.

primary_source.applicability: Nintendo original family reference; not the exact Sheriff board revision.
primary_source.render: Bundled Windows Poppler pdftoppm.exe -scale-to 6000 -png; page image 6000x3883.

connections.5J_ENT10: 5I RCO15. Both ENP inputs must also be high to count.
connections.5I_LOAD9_5J_LOAD9: High; CLR1 also held high in the drawn network. Native reset is an artificial origin.
connections.V0_V3: 5I QA14/QB13/QC12/QD11 through the four 5K XOR channels with RV.
connections.V4_V7: 5J QA14/QB13/QC12/QD11 through the four 5L XOR channels with RV.
connections.QA_omission_rejected: QA feeds V0; the lowest vertical counter bit is NOT omitted from the RAM address.
connections.5I_CLK2_5J_CLK2: Common CK/4. CLK wires cross the ENP risers without junction dots.
connections.5I_ENP7_5J_ENP7: Independent risers join HB_n, the active-horizontal 4G Qbar6 feedback. NOT tied to CLK.

conditional_extension_negative_check.algorithm: Existing isolated horizontal model plus one vertical increment per sampled terminal carry.
conditional_extension_negative_check.reference: Local MAME 0.289 n8080.cpp Sheriff set_raw specifies 320 total horizontal clocks and 256 total lines.
conditional_extension_negative_check.conclusion: Historical negative: counting every terminal carry omitted active-horizontal ENP gating. The related wiring now resolves this contradiction; no arbitrary divide-by-two was added.

limitations: Connected ideal enable/VB behavior is source-qualified on related Bandido/TSF; exact Sheriff net/revision remains an applicability limit.
C5/load/RCO propagation, chip grade/setup/hold and absolute reset/visible/IRQ origin remain unqualified.
Physical DRAM/readback/READY and serializer/PROM/RGB alignment still require integration qualification.
Module is outside files.qip; production board is unchanged. No field2760 waiver, graphics or fit/resource pass follows.

corrected_extension_check.software_derivation_scope: Connected ideal enables only; reuses native terminal evidence, not a replacement for it.

vertical_blank.D12: AND of 5J QB13/QC12/QD11, via LS20 and inversion: V5 & V6 & V7.
vertical_blank.Q9: VB high blank; Qbar8 high active.
vertical_blank.ideal_transitions: clear VB at vertical16; set VB at vertical240;224 active rows.
vertical_blank.origin_limit: Digital reset v=0/VB=1 is repeatable bench state, not verified PCB power-up/reset.

correction.superseded_clock_enable_claim: CLK2/ENP7 tied to CK/4 was a source-reading error.
correction.transform: Crop plus black/white polarity inversion for legibility; no circuit redrawn.

ttl_source.semantics: Both P/ENP and T/ENT high to count; T enables carry. ENP gates both vertical cascade stages.
